newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 96 construct output +4.7pct, Dec output dips.
newsitem.headline: Czech 96 construct output +4.7pct, Dec output dips.

text.p: Construction output in the Czech Republic rose 4.7 percent for 1996 in real terms, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Tuesday.
It added in a statement that construction output, in real terms, fell 5.7 percent in December over the same period in 1995.
CONSTRUCTION OUTPUT DEC/96 NOV/96 DEC/95 JAN-DEC/96
Note: Output figures are based on all sizes of companies. Wage figures are calculated only on the basis of companies with 25 or more employees.

The CSU said that the average wage in the construction sector in December was 11,691 crowns, up from 9,883 crowns in the same month last year. It added that the total number of employees in the sector dropped by 2.5 percent, year- on-year, to 208,100 workers.
